name: FloodWatch South India DEM terrain/wetness sampling cells

metadata.dem_source: Copernicus WorldDEM-90 / Copernicus DEM GLO-90 public COG tiles
metadata.state_mask_source: data/south-india-states.geojson; approximate mask, not official survey boundary
metadata.attribution: Produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-90 © DLR e.V. 2010–2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014–2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved.
metadata.note: Static, relative topographic wetness context from DEM conditioning, slope, D8 flow accumulation and TWI. It does not include rainfall, river stage, reservoir releases, hydraulic routing or water depth. Not an inundation extent, calibrated flood probability or official warning. Raster is resampled to an approximately 2.2 km grid for regional visualization. Transparent/unmapped areas mean unknown data, not safety.
